The '''Great Mesra Plateau''', also known as the '''Mesric Plateau''', was a highland area on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It stretched from the [[Xelric Draw/Legends|Xelric Draw]] to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].

==History==
It was the location of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] camp that [[Alkhara/Legends|Alkhara]] massacred.<ref name="ItWoSWR" />

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'' mislabels this area the "Great '''Mesa''' Plateau."

The Great Mesra Plateau appeared as a designated planetary region in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the plateau was identified as the "Mesric Plateau."<ref name="SWG" />
